name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $91 on 26 Nov, 21% lower over a month; Hormuz traffic down 40% but no new 2 mb/d outage confirmed
state: Brent was near $91.0 early on 26 Nov, 1.1% lower on the week and 21% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Hormuz crossings fell from 226 vessels on 1–7 Nov to 125 on 17–23 Nov, Marine Traffic data show (Al Jazeera, 24 Nov), and the Houthis said they hit Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery on 25 Nov (Middle East Eye). No new outage above 2 mb/d is confirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: Fuel prices stay above last year's levels and remain exposed to further Gulf disruption. Households and transport firms are most affected.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Hormuz oil traffic is down 40 percent: are Iran's tanker attacks working?

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
